messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGERDUTY ALERT: latency.p99 for inference-api crossed 1200ms (SLO burn). Trigger: latency.alert.rule-462. Link: https://pd.redwood.example/incidents/INC-462
pagerduty: Pager triggered -> INC-462 assigned to `lyla (oncall)`
lyla (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Gathering quick metrics.
ajay: saw increased tail in EU region around 18:42 UTC, maybe kv-cache evictions?
maria: corroborating, redis evict rate spiked, some heavy rerank requests showed large seq lengths.
lyla (oncall): Quick check: p95 ~ 320ms -> normal, p99 ~ 1.3s -> spike. Affected region: eu-west-1.
sam (sre): tagging autoscaler to watch node spin-up. Can we throttle noncritical batch jobs?
ajay: rolling out throttle for background batches now (route: /batch/* -> rate-limit 50rps).
maria: adding temporary rule to prefer smaller model variant for canary customers. Patch in console: service-routing -> fallback-model: redwood-small-v2.
lyla (oncall): Running small mitigation: 1) throttle background; 2) enable fallback-model for non-SLA customers; 3) warm KV caches on hot shards.
incident-bot: Action recorded: throttles + routing change applied by maria.
lyla (oncall): KV warmup script running: ```for shard in hot_shards; do curl -X POST https://internal/cache/warm/$shard; done```
sam (sre): autoscaler observed 2 additional machines provisioning, ETA ~70s.
ajay: noticed one host with high GPU mem (>90%) — evicting large-batch worker. Kicking a restart for that pod.
maria: restarted worker pod on node gpu-23. Watch for queue draining.
lyla (oncall): p99 dropped to ~780ms after throttles and fallback, p95 stable. Keeping watch.
pagerduty: INC-462: acknowledged by lyla. Escalation policy paused.
ajay: customer-impact check: small % of requests experienced >1s responses, CS alert created for 12 customers in EU.
maria: created a short bulletin draft: "We're experiencing elevated tail latency in EU; mitigation in progress; minimal customer impact for SLA customers."
lyla (oncall): Handing off to night oncall (sam) in 25m. Will leave remediation checklist in incident doc and set alert suppression for noisy duplicate pages.
sam (sre): taking handoff. Confirming fallback-model remains active, autoscaler stabilized.
lyla (oncall): final note before handoff: follow-up items — investigate root cause of cache eviction (maybe hotkey pattern), add guardrail to limit very-long-sequence rerank jobs, add metric to detect slowfall for redundant model routing.
sam (sre): acknowledged. I'll open a follow-up ticket and loop in research for model-serve memory analysis.
incident-bot: Incident INC-462 updated: status -> monitoring. Last action: handoff to sam (sre).
lyla (oncall): Thanks all. If p99 rebounds above 1s re-alert me and escalate to eng-sre. :thumbsup:
